    26	\subsection{Proportional Controller with Budget Constraint}
    27	
    28	We smooth the raw signal with an exponential moving average:
    29	\begin{equation}
    30	  \tilde{S}_t = \alpha \cdot S_t + (1 - \alpha) \cdot \tilde{S}_{t-1}, \quad \alpha = 0.5
    31	\end{equation}

    37	\end{equation}
